About the Programme This two-year postgraduate programme is designed to provide students with advanced knowledge in business and commerce, aligned with current industry trends. The curriculum: Covers subjects such as business administration, accounting and finance ensuring students have diverse career paths. Focuses on developing managerial and analytical skills. Combines theoretical learning and practical training. Vision To be a leader in commerce education by promoting excellence and innovation, empowering students for global success and societal impact. We are committed to developing adaptable, sustainable and ethical professionals for the evolving business landscape. Mission The M.Com programme by the Department of Commerce at SSMRV aims to blend theory and practice to equip students for business success. We aim to nurture future leaders by fostering entrepreneurship, ethical responsibility and opportunities for growth and leadership.
